checks.new_runs: Both wrappers run Gaussian Neal2/3/8 and Poisson Neal8; saved joint/partition targets reconstructed independently; seeded draws/allocations/parameters/diagnostics byte-identical across wrappers.

independent_review.scope: Separate core agent checked Neal2/3/8 against Neal2000, canonical atom correspondence, singleton recycling and failure paths, reran the initial 951-check suite, then reviewed CLI and integration; no material defect reported.

corrections.description: A one-point range endpoint fixture was corrected after its initial construction error.
Poisson MH differences now cancel factorial constants and centre small exponential changes. Fourteen additional checks include 256-bit BigFloat large-count references; final kernel suite965 checks.

limits: Gaussian component variances and DP strength are fixed; conjugate operations are implemented only for GaussianLocation.
PoissonLogRate supports Neal8 with an invariant single-step RWM component update; Neal2/3 are rejected for it.
Tiny three-observation posterior checks do not establish general mixing or runtime performance.
Float64 full joint density values may lose absolute precision for very large counts even when MH ratio evaluation is stabilised.
Other model families, split-merge and tempering for these states remain unsupported.
